description: Retrieve a use case together with the full development context of its owning project (architecture, tech stack, repository, coding standards, auth strategy, quality gates, deployment, external services, developed endpoints, and stats). Use this tool whenever an AI agent needs to implement a software feature from a use case, so it can align the implementation with the project's architecture and conventions.

useCaseId.description: The unique identifier (_id) of the use case to retrieve together with its full project context

name: getUseCaseWithProjectContext
